rationale: The buyer is a specific, named business role (sales reps, founders, BD professionals at SMBs) who clearly pays for solutions — DocSend costs $45-150/user/mo and Pitch/Notion are widely adopted — making willingness to pay the strongest signal here. However, this is NOT a Claude-prompt-plus-a-form build: dynamic watermarking, per-page view analytics, NDA gating, branded data rooms, and multi-format rendering (PDF/DOCX/PPTX/XLSX/video) require significant infra (document rendering pipeline, analytics event capture, CDN delivery) that is far beyond what the Claude factory can ship in a week. The build_gate on buildability_with_ai (scored 3, floor is 6) is the deciding factor — this is a well-validated market with real paying buyers, but the product is too technically complex for a solo non-technical operator using this tooling.
solution_plan: This is a document-sharing analytics platform (think lightweight DocSend): secure links, page-level engagement tracking, NDA gating, and branded data rooms. To build it properly you would need a document rendering service (e.g. PDF.js or a hosted renderer), a real-time analytics event pipeline, CDN-hosted delivery with access controls, and dynamic watermarking — none of which the Claude factory can assemble without significant engineering. A Claude prompt alone cannot render PPTX or embed per-page tracking pixels. The honest answer: a solo non-technical operator using this factory CANNOT build a credible version of this product; what you could do instead is validate demand by building a stripped-down MVP (PDF-only, page analytics via a third-party embed like Tally/Typeform + a Notion-hosted data room) and charge $49/mo to 5 pilot customers before commissioning a proper build. Outreach: post in relevant Slack communities (RevOps Co-op, Pavilion) and cold-email sales directors at 50-person B2B companies — approval needed before any sends go out.
notes: Failing build_gate: buildability_with_ai scored 3 (floor: 6). Dynamic watermarking, multi-format rendering, and real-time page-analytics are outside Claude+form+Stripe tooling. Validate demand first with a stripped-down manual/third-party MVP.
